literal: To those who live, like what the sky yielded indeed, to those who love, is the affection that the beloved bestow.
translation: Just as the rain from the sky sustains those who live on earth, the affection bestowed by the beloved sustains those who love them.
modern: வாழும் மக்களுக்கு வானம் மழை பொழிந்து உதவுவது போல, காதலிப்பவர்களுக்கு அவர்கள் காதலிப்பவர் காட்டும் அன்பானது அமைகிறது.
explanation: This couplet compares the life-giving nature of rain to the sustaining power of a beloved's affection. For those who live in the world, the rain from the sky (வானம்) is essential for survival, yielding (பயந்து) timely sustenance. Similarly, for those who are deeply in love (வீழ்வார்க்கு), the grace and affection (அளி) bestowed by their beloved (வீழ்வார்) is the very source of their life. Without the beloved's love, the lover cannot survive, just as the world cannot survive without rain.
